extraction.tool: Original native scan / closed-form edge alpha and foreground decontamination
extraction.ownership_guide_prompt: Use case: faithful historical illustration or ornament extraction. Edit the ORIGINAL supplied source region. ONLY the original contacting architecture: the complete scalloped burgundy-and-gold semicircular arch, gold horizontal lintel, both twisted red columns, green/blue capitals and complete original column bases. Remove the angel, central seated writer, both sky fields, all empty flat gold field, all flat burgundy rectangle around the actual architecture, the green floor between column bases and the thin external rectangular gold painting outline. Keep original relative positions and source perspective. The arcade is open at bottom; do not fabricate a bottom connector or pillars. All real openings become transparent. Keep the entire selected original subject at its original proportions: every original fingertip, toe, petal fold, serration, thin stem, curl, feather, painted highlight and print hatching. Clear the unwanted page or flat painted background and every genuine opening between subject parts. Selected pale, gold, blue or white painted or engraved subject surfaces remain opaque. Remove neighboring unrelated subjects and printed page rules, lettering or captions. Preserve only source-visible parts, including original truncated ends; no invented hidden anatomy, new leaves, new tips, extended stalks, restored details or modern replacement artwork. Do not symmetrize, beautify, redraw, sharpen, stretch or compress the hand-drawn original. Fine natural antialiased contours without stepped polygon cuts or paper halos. Genuine transparent alpha outside and within the real openings, no rectangle or checkerboard paint.

retained_generated_ownership_guide.purpose: Retained AI alpha guide only; delivered opaque RGB belongs to the unchanged native source.

review.notes: Complete original architecture reviewed with unchanged source and whole white/dark comparisons, then actual-native capitals/bases and arch apex. Blue-gray pale paint is opaque, all source-visible column folds and collars retained. Exterior burgundy/gilt/green page fields and separately retained figures removed; the real source occlusion at the angel wing remains a small notch in the inner gold band. Native proportions and original unequal bases preserved; no generic corner, repeat or hidden gold repair.

assets.usage_notes: Whole original scalloped arch, lintel and paired twisted columns with unequal bases. Original native shading, green capitals and blue-gray folds remain opaque. The original angel wing overlaps the inner gilt arch at its apex; that source-visible notch is retained when the separate angel is removed, without reconstructing hidden gold. No repeat, fabricated corner, hidden paint or SVG redraw.

transparent_cleanup.method: Clear alpha <= 2/255 only more than three native pixels from alpha > 8/255; clear hidden RGB at alpha zero. Real edge alpha and visible color retained.

native_subject_size_evidence.method: Individually inspected native visible subject bounds, excluding input-region whitespace and neighbours.

review.notes: Compared original region and white/dark native-cap renders. Full visible figures, green leg armor, contacting lion, original props, wing colors and genuine harp/desk openings checked. Two visible busts retain only source-visible lower edges; no invented hidden legs. Three other batch outputs separately rejected for correction.
